Calculate Summary Statistics Table

Source: R/calculate_summary_stats_table.R
calculate_summary_stats_table.Rd

This function calculates summary statistics (mean, standard deviation, standard error, quantiles) for numeric columns in a data frame, creates a flextable for formatted output, and saves the table in a Word document and CSV file.

calculate_summary_stats_table(data, output_path = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the data to be summarized.

output_path

A character string specifying the output path for the Word document. Default is NULL, which sets the output path to "post_eval_summary.docx".

Value

A flextable object containing the summary statistics.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Calculate summary statistics and save the table to a Word document
summary_table <- calculate_summary_stats_table(initial_stat_ASV, output_path = "summary.docx")

# Read a post-evaluation summary from a CSV file
post_eval_summary <- read.csv("post_eval_summary.csv")

# Print the calculated summary table
print(summary_table)

# Preview the post-evaluation summary
head(post_eval_summary)
} # }
